name: docmost-knowledge
description: Search, maintain, and cite a private Docmost knowledge base through a Keychain-authenticated MCP connection.

interface.shortDescription: Use a private Docmost knowledge base safely from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Docmost Knowledge gives Codex permission-aware search, page editing, version history, attachment, and vector-index workflows. A local stdio proxy reads the bearer token from macOS Keychain and forwards requests only over HTTPS without storing credentials in the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Search my Docmost knowledge base before answering.
Save these notes to the appropriate Docmost space.
Summarize this topic and cite the Docmost pages you used.
Compare the recent versions of this Docmost page.
